explanation: This slide details emergency scenarios that involve chemical or sample exposure. These incidents include: chemical/sample splashes to the eyes, general spills, skin or clothing contact with a hazardous substance, chemical ingestion (swallowing), and inhalation of hazardous vapors.

questions.q: What type of emergency scenario involving eye exposure is highlighted on this page?
opts: Dropping a pair of safety goggles
Chemical or sample splash to the eyes
